name: deployment-events
description: Carries Harbor.Deployment.DeploymentLifecycleEvent messages. Produced by Harbor.Deployment on every deployment status change and consumed by the same service to reconcile status written by GitHub Actions webhooks.

partitions.note: Partition count is immutable on the Event Hubs Standard tier, so it is fixed at creation time. Partitions are not billed.
partitions.guidance: Partitions cap consumer parallelism. Raise only if sustained ingress exceeds ~1,000 events/sec, and prefer migrating to Premium/Dedicated first, where partitions can be added after creation.

retention.local: 7d (Apache Kafka broker default; the compose broker in docker-compose.yml does not override KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS)
retention.guidance: The consumer is a status reconciler, not an audit log. Events older than the retention window are intentionally dropped rather than replayed, because the PostgreSQL deployments table is the system of record.

azure.service: Azure Event Hubs (Standard tier, 1 throughput unit)
azure.entityPathNote: KafkaOptions.ApplyConnectionString() derives the topic from EntityPath, so the Event Hubs name and the value of KAFKA_DEPLOYMENT_TOPIC must be identical. A namespace-level connection string without EntityPath silently disables both the producer and the consumer.
